ms.promise:
Deploy Hydra head for instant ADA/CNT settlement.
Implement hybrid mode for L1/L2 fallback.
Run merchant pilot with at least 2 test environments.
Capture transaction speed, stability, and UX feedback.
ms.criteria:
Hydra payment processing works reliably in testnet and mainnet pilots.
Fallback to Layer 1 works without breaking merchant flow when L2 is unavailable.
Merchant Pilot feedback is collected and documented.
ms.report:
A. Output: Deployed Hydra head for instant ADA/CNT settlement with full merchant and customer payment flows.
Acceptance criteria: Hydra payment processing works reliably in testnet and mainnet pilots. The system routes payments through Hydra L2 state channels with ~380ms confirmation time, handling 104 L2 payments during the pilot period with a 94.2% success rate.
Evidence:
・Hydra L2 integration source code: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/tree/main/merchant-pos/src/server/hydra
・Merchant dashboard (payment intent creation): https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/merchant-pos/src/pages/merchant.tsx
・Customer payment page (Hydra L2 checkout): https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/merchant-pos/src/pages/customer.tsx
・Merchant-side demo video: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/docs/demo-videos/05-merchant-hydra-intent-flow.mp4
・Customer-side demo video: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/docs/demo-videos/06-customer-hydra-payment.mp4

B. Output: Implemented hybrid L1/L2 fallback mode ensuring uninterrupted merchant operations when Hydra head is unavailable.
Acceptance criteria: Fallback to Layer 1 works without breaking merchant flow when L2 is unavailable. During the pilot, 6 automatic fallback events occurred — all handled transparently without merchant intervention. The smart routing layer selects L2 when the Hydra head is Open and automatically falls back to L1 on-chain settlement otherwise.
Evidence:
・Payment router with settlement layer selection and fallback logic: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/merchant-pos/src/server/hydra/payment-router.ts
・Hydra head facade with WebSocket reconnection: http

ms.promise:
Mainnet release of Hydra Point-of-Sale under MIT License.

Deliver final report including adoption metrics and next steps.
ms.criteria:
Mainnet-ready code uploaded to Github, downloadable and installable by the public.

ms.report:
A. Output: Mainnet release of Hydra Point-of-Sale under MIT License — a self-hosted, open-source point-of-sale + invoicing toolkit that accepts ADA and Cardano Native Tokens (CNTs) with Hydra Layer-2 settlement on Cardano mainnet. Real ADA, real Hydra heads, real CIP-30 wallets. Mainnet-ready code is downloadable + installable by the public via tagged GitHub Releases and a one-shot docker compose stack.
Acceptance criteria: Mainnet-ready code uploaded to GitHub, downloadable and installable by the public.
Evidence:
・v1.0.0 release (mainnet baseline): https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/releases/tag/v1.0.0
・v2.0.0 release (hybrid-custody mainnet rewrite — better retail customer + business experience): https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/releases/tag/v2.0.0
・MIT License: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/LICENSE
・One-shot mainnet docker compose stack: https://github.com/Trivolve-Tech/Hydra-Point-of-Sale-Accept-ADA-CNTs-in-Retail-Invoicing/blob/main/docker/docker-compose.mainnet.yml

B. Output: Full deployment and integration documentation — a publicly hosted documentation site plus a complete in-repo ops handbook (mainnet deployment, key custody, incident playbook, --deposit-period tuning) and the hybrid-custody architecture write-up.
Acceptance criteria: Documentation and setup guide completed and hosted publicly.
Evidence:
